target.statement: FID of 28.531 for the Real→Cartoon cross-domain reenactment task (our full model)
target.dataset: VoxCeleb (real driving videos) + self-collected Disney-style cartoon dataset (source images)

compute.basis: Training requires 450K iterations at batch size 64 on VoxCeleb plus 10K fine-tuning iterations on the cartoon dataset, which is far beyond a few hours on an 8-core CPU laptop; the cartoon dataset is not yet released and no code is provided.

blockers: No code or model weights released
Cartoon dataset not publicly available (only promised for future release)
Requires training a GAN-based transformer model for 450K+ iterations
Needs GPU for feasible training time
title: ToonTalker: Cross-Domain Face Reenactment
